title: FanRGB driver catalog
description: Latest vendor driver versions, built weekly by .github/workflows/driver-catalog.yml and signed with the dedicated catalog minisign key (drivers.json.minisig, trusted comment 'fanrgb-catalog serial=<serial> drivers.json'). The app (src/drivers/catalog) enforces everything here plus the signature, the serial replay rule and the URL host allow-list (allowed-hosts.json). schema_version is MAJOR.MINOR: the app refuses another major; a newer minor may only add optional fields, which older apps ignore.

serial.description: Raised by one for every published catalog. The app refuses a serial lower than one it has seen, and the same serial with different bytes.

expires.description: generated_at + 21 days by default (at most 90 days). After it the app still shows the list, marked out of date.

text.description: Short display text: no control, invisible or bidi characters, single spaces only.

url.description: https only, on a host listed in allowed-hosts.json, default port, characters A-Z a-z 0-9 - . _ ~ / ? # & = + , ; : only, at most 300 characters.

version.description: In the format of version_scheme (see src/drivers/catalog/version.rs).

version_scheme.description: intel-gfx: 32.0.101.NNNN, ordered by the build (third, then fourth part). amd-chipset: x.yy.zz.nnn package version. realtek-lan: package 10.NN.VV (NDIS) or 11.0NN.VV (NetAdapterCx), compared with driver 10.NN.* / 11xx.NN.*. numeric: 2-5 numeric parts. gigabyte-bios: F<number>[letter], F36 < F36a < F36d < F37.

checked_at.description: When the entry was last confirmed against its source (not refreshed when an adapter fails). Not after generated_at.

match.description: All given rules must hold; within a list any value may match. At least one of hardware_ids, packages, board.

hardware_ids.description: PnP hardware/compatible ID patterns, case-insensitive, * and ? wildcards, at least 8 literal characters before the first wildcard.

providers.description: Case-insensitive substrings of the INF provider.

packages.description: Installer package names (Windows Uninstall DisplayName), case-insensitive.
